name: Index card flip
oneLiner: a real ruled index card is tossed onto a walnut desk, a question writes itself on in ballpoint, then the card lifts and flips on twos to show the answer in a fat brand-colour marker, underlined twice
say: when the speaker asks a question and then answers it ('so what actually works? consistency'): the question writes on as they ask it and the card flips on the answer
